SOL-871.summary: Generate structured JSON-LD data with a Chrome extension for Squarespace content.
SOL-871.details: JSONify is aimed at making site content easier for search engines and AI systems to interpret through structured data.

SOL-872.summary: Reveal hidden content when visitors hover or tap a Squarespace List item.
SOL-872.details: List Section Reveal keeps the image visible first, then animates additional content into view.

SOL-873.summary: Give Squarespace Simple Lists more flexible layouts and video support.
SOL-873.details: Simple List Flex expands the default list design into more customizable horizontal and media-rich arrangements.

SOL-874.summary: Create a scroll-triggered zoom effect for Squarespace images and GIFs.
SOL-874.details: Zoomify enlarges visual content as the visitor scrolls, creating a full-screen reveal effect.

SOL-875.summary: Ask visitors to confirm their age before viewing a Squarespace site.
SOL-875.details: SF Digital’s Age Popup adds an age-verification gate for sites with age-restricted or sensitive content.

SOL-876.summary: Let shoppers save Squarespace products to a personal favourites list.
SOL-876.details: Favourites gives visitors a shortlist they can return to while browsing a store.

SOL-877.summary: Replace Add to Cart with an enquiry or custom-order action on selected products.
SOL-877.details: Product Enquiry Form is useful for made-to-order products, services, quotes, or items that should not be purchased directly.

SOL-878.summary: Let customers collect products into a wishlist and send the list to you.
SOL-878.details: SF Digital’s Wishlist supports quote, rental, and enquiry workflows rather than ordinary checkout.

SOL-879.summary: Restore a product-category dropdown on mobile Squarespace store pages.
SOL-879.details: The plugin gives mobile shoppers a compact way to switch among store categories.

SOL-880.summary: Add an accordion below the Add to Cart area on Squarespace product pages.
SOL-880.details: Use collapsible sections for details such as sizing, shipping, FAQs, or care instructions.

SOL-881.summary: Show product lead-time information on Squarespace stores.
SOL-881.details: Add clear production or dispatch timing messages for made-to-order and custom products.

SOL-882.summary: Display portrait and landscape product images without forcing one aspect ratio.
SOL-882.details: The plugin adjusts Squarespace store imagery so mixed image orientations display more naturally.

SOL-883.summary: Add a sticky call-to-action bar on mobile Squarespace pages.
SOL-883.details: Keep an important action such as call, book, enquire, or buy visible at the bottom of smaller screens.

SOL-884.summary: Display social icons using their recognizable brand colors.
SOL-884.details: Adds original service colors to Squarespace social icons instead of one uniform site color.

SOL-885.summary: Add a clearer order-confirmation message to the Squarespace order-status page.
SOL-885.details: The plugin inserts reassurance above the order details after checkout.

SOL-886.summary: Sell fractional quantities such as metres, yards, kilograms, or pounds.
SOL-886.details: Fractional Quantities makes it easier to sell products that are purchased in partial units.

SOL-887.summary: Make Squarespace navigation folders clickable as well as expandable.
SOL-887.details: Visitors can click a parent navigation label instead of using it only to open its dropdown.

SOL-888.summary: Animate an underline beneath Squarespace desktop navigation links on hover.
SOL-888.details: A lightweight CSS treatment adds motion and emphasis to header navigation.

SOL-889.summary: Split long Squarespace product titles across multiple lines.
SOL-889.details: Adds controlled line breaks to product-page titles for cleaner formatting.

SOL-890.summary: Add custom trust or information text to the Squarespace cart page.
SOL-890.details: Use the cart area for delivery notes, reassurance, policies, or other checkout-adjacent messaging.

SOL-891.summary: Make an entire Squarespace List item clickable instead of only its button.
SOL-891.details: Visitors can tap or click anywhere on the card to follow the item’s link.

SOL-892.summary: Warn visitors when an in-app browser may interfere with Squarespace forms or checkout.
SOL-892.details: Adds a notice encouraging users to open the site in a full browser when embedded browsers cause limitations.

SOL-893.summary: Add a prominent Quick Exit control to sensitive Squarespace websites.
SOL-893.details: A fast-exit button can help visitors leave crisis-support or safety-related sites quickly.

SOL-894.summary: Stack Squarespace product images vertically on mobile as well as desktop.
SOL-894.details: The plugin changes mobile product galleries from swipe-based presentation to a visible image stack.
